第七步_UT描述核验与EKR继续决策_20261006.md
commands.text:
(
  set -euo pipefail
  CPF_PY="$CPF_PY"
  ROOT=${PROJECT}
  SCRIPT=/tmp/export_train_review_paths_20261006.py
  MAP=/tmp/ut_train_path_aliases_20261006.json
  AUDIT=/tmp/ut_train_image_audit_20261006_v1.json
  IMAGE_ROOT="$ROOT/data/ut-zap50k/_images_extract/ut-zap50k-images-square"
  OUT=/tmp/ut_train_review_images_20261006_v1
  test -s "$SCRIPT"
  test -s "$MAP"
  test -s "$AUDIT"
  "$CPF_PY" -I -c 'import torch; from PIL import Image; print("REVIEW ENV OK", torch.__version__)'
  test -d "$IMAGE_ROOT"
  test ! -e "$OUT"
  test ! -e "$OUT.zip"
  ARGS=(
    --data "$ROOT/data/ut-zap50k"
    --knowledge "$ROOT/knowledge/kcc0601_v1/trusted_v1/ut-zap50k"
    --image-root "$IMAGE_ROOT"
    --image-field _image
    --path-map "$MAP" --audit-report "$AUDIT"
    --seed 20261006 --max-per-class 20 --out "$OUT"
  )
  "$CPF_PY" -I -u "$SCRIPT" "${ARGS[@]}" --check-images-only
  "$CPF_PY" -I -u "$SCRIPT" "${ARGS[@]}"
  sha256sum "$OUT.zip"
  du -h "$OUT.zip"
)

commands.source: 第七步_UT描述核验与EKR继续决策_20261006.md
commands.text:
(
  set -euo pipefail
  source ${PROJECT}/experiments/ekr0601_transition_v1/protocol/session_env.sh
  test -s "$LEGACY/runs/mvp_ut-zappos_C_legacy_s3351_l0/checkpoints/best_auc.pth"
  STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
  SMOKE_OUT=/tmp/ekr_interface_recheck_20261006_$STAMP
  mkdir -p "$SMOKE_OUT"
  "$CPF_PY" -m transition.cli make-configs \
    --root "$ROOT" --exp "$EXP" --legacy-exp "$LEGACY" --bank-root "$BANK_ROOT" \
    --stage branch --datasets ut-zappos --seeds 3351 --epochs 3 \
    --variants R0 R3 R5 R7 --use-legacy-anchor --smoke-only
  for variant in R0 R3 R5 R7; do
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU" "$CPF_PY" -u -m transition.cli smoke \
      --cfg "$EXP/configs/smoke_ut-zappos_${variant}_s3351_e3.yml" \
      --out "$SMOKE_OUT/${variant}.json" \
      2>&1 | tee "$SMOKE_OUT/${variant}.log"
  done
)

训练图导出路径报错_检查与v2修复_20261006.md
commands.text:
"$CPF_PY" -I - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
data = Path('${PROJECT}/data/ut-zap50k')
relative = 'Boots/Ankle/Dr. Martens/8004440.365149.jpg'
logical_root = data / 'images'
root = logical_root.resolve()
target = (logical_root / relative).resolve()
print('IMAGES_IS_SYMLINK:', logical_root.is_symlink())
print('IMAGE_ROOT_REAL:', root)
print('TARGET_REAL:', target)
print('TARGET_WITHIN_ROOT:', root in target.parents)
print('FILE_EXISTS:', target.is_file())
try:
    print('FILE_SIZE:', target.stat().st_size)
    with target.open('rb') as stream:
        print('FILE_READ_OK:', stream.read(8).hex())
except OSError as error:
    print('FILE_ACCESS_ERROR:', type(error).__name__, 'errno=', error.errno)
candidate = data / '_images_extract' / 'ut-zap50k-images-square'
print('CANDIDATE_ROOT:', candidate)
print('CANDIDATE_FILE_EXISTS:', (candidate / relative).is_file())
PY
